title: Quadratic linear proof word
statement: Given a Boolean word $w$ of length $n$, define a Boolean proof word of length $n+2(n+1)$ in three blocks. At position $i<n$, its bit is the product over $\mathbb F_2$ of the linear-prefix bit of $w$ at $i$ and the bit $w_i$; in the next block, the bits are the linear-prefix bits of $w$, and in the final block they are the quadratic-prefix bits of $w$.
caveat: The formal statement uses auxiliary prefix-bit functions whose definitions are not included in the supplied material.
